summary: Preserved the candidate's DiffGenerator sleep, wake, and refit API and corrected its concrete transport counterexample: exceptions raised by sync_scheduler_client.forward are now normalized to lifecycle-specific RuntimeError instances with the original exception chained as the cause.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction against exact candidate 7f6725c124ac107fbc06daa0810757488cb6ea28 with only the regression added: ConnectionError escaped _send_lifecycle_request unchanged.
13 tests passed after correction, including ConnectionError and TimeoutError normalization and the candidate's prior lifecycle and compatibility coverage.
All applicable formatting, lint, spelling, syntax, and repository policy hooks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was used as evidence for this transport-only correction. The candidate and review GPU round trips exercised MemoryOccupationController code already present in the base, not the new DiffGenerator transport surface with a real diffusion model.

remaining_limitations: No real diffusion checkpoint was available, so model-specific sleep, wake, generation, refit, and memory behavior remain unverified.
No end-to-end sleep+wake+refit versus kill-and-relaunch timing comparison was possible without a qualifying diffusion checkpoint.
FSDP inference sleep/wake remains explicitly unsupported.
The corrected transport surface was tested deterministically with scheduler-forward failures, not end to end through a real diffusion scheduler and checkpoint.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify diffusion architecture behavior and was not used.
